# Preserve custom config while creating and then reusing installer state.
! exists $WORK/.openshift_install_state.json

exec openshift-install agent create agent-config-template --dir $WORK
stderr 'level=info msg=Agent-Config-Template created in:'
cmp $WORK/agent-config.yaml $WORK/expected/agent-config.yaml
exists $WORK/.openshift_install_state.json

exec openshift-install agent create agent-config-template --dir $WORK
stderr 'level=info msg=Agent-Config-Template created in:'
cmp $WORK/agent-config.yaml $WORK/expected/agent-config.yaml

-- agent-config.yaml --
# custom comment preserved
apiVersion: v1beta1
kind: AgentConfig
metadata:
  name: test-cluster
rendezvousIP: 192.168.1.100
-- expected/agent-config.yaml --
# custom comment preserved
apiVersion: v1beta1
kind: AgentConfig
metadata:
  name: test-cluster
rendezvousIP: 192.168.1.100
